description: This file defines internal API function prototypes related to TLS Session Entry management, including session state handling and connection matching functions in the TLS implementation module.

methods.name: TlsSeoGetSessionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current session state for the TLS session entry object.

methods.name: TlsSeoSetSessionState
methods.description: Sets the session state for the TLS session entry object.

methods.name: TlsSeoReset
methods.description: Resets the TLS session entry object to its default state.

methods.name: TlsSeoMatch1
methods.description: Determines if the TLS session entry matches specific host and peer IDs with connection end.

methods.name: TlsSeoMatch2
methods.description: Determines if the TLS session entry matches specific host and peer IDs along with a session ID of specified size.
